bibliographic.title: Smitten Kittens
bibliographic.author: Jacqueline A. Lott
bibliographic.description:
Ensigns Anne Blackwell and John Jemison have known each other most of their lives, but are they prepared for the changes that lie ahead after they're stationed together aboard the USS Enterprise?

This is a short intro game, conceived and created for the Star Trek Game Jam. It contains many different conversation paths with both Guinan and John, and has three possible endings. Note that your mood is affected by your behavior and the behavior of others, and that this sometimes influences which conversation options are available to you. It is likely worthwhile to play the game more than once.
